summary: These are two slide header declarations that set background images for presentation slides. The first one uses a default background size, while the second explicitly specifies that the image should fit entirely within the slide without being cropped.

explanations.1: This creates a slide header with a background image from the 2024.jpg file; without specifying background-size, it will use the default behavior (usually 'cover', which crops the image to fill the space).
explanations.3: The background-size property set to 'contain' means the entire image will be visible and scaled to fit inside the slide, even if it leaves empty space around it.
